findings.title: Removed traceID from plugin request completion log
findings.body: The old logRequest appended a traceID field via tracing.TraceIDFromContext. This PR removes it and relies on logger.FromContext(ctx), but nothing visible in the diff adds traceID to the contextual attributes. If the infra logger's FromContext does not inject the trace ID itself, the 'Plugin Request Completed' egress log loses its traceID field. That would break log/trace correlation for anyone querying on it.

findings.title: FromContext fallback discards contextual attributes
findings.body: If infra log's FromContext returns something other than *log.ConcreteLogger, the wrapper silently falls back to d.New(), which carries no context attributes. The log line would then lose pluginId, endpoint, dsName and the other fields with no warning.

findings.title: Adding method to exported Logger interface breaks implementers
findings.body: FromContext is added to the exported plugins Logger interface. Any other implementations, such as fakes in other packages or enterprise code, will fail to compile. The doc comment is also inaccurate: it says the method adds 'the given context', but it actually derives the logger from attributes stored in the context.Context.
